afk_notes: Autopilot/route macros. Require manual load+unload interaction at each stop.
Needs real passengers. Do not pay for empty circling.
Fixed repeating route is trivially macro-able. Randomise stops or drop it.
Repetitive pickup loop. Vary spawn points.
Single repeated keypress. Needs minigame variance and per-hour diminishing returns.
Same as fishing. Worst offender historically.
Animal spawns force movement. Safer than fishing.
Growth timers pay for being logged in. Require harvest interaction only.
Requires another player to have a broken car. Self-limiting.
Commission only. No sale no pay.
Passive drink sales must be capped and require staff online.
Timer salary is the classic AFK farm. Pay per completed call NOT per minute connected.
Same as EMS. Pay per report filed / arrest processed.
Expected value after arrest chance and fines.
Chop shop payout must require driving it there manually.
Do not pay for standing in a zone. Require an NPC/player transaction.
Offline or idle production timers print money for doing nothing. Requires active tending.
Long cooldown. Big loss on failure. The highest ceiling in the game.
